# Toolkit patches (generated by installer/tools/patch_index.py, do not edit)

Applied in name order to the pinned toolkit by installer/tools/export_toolkit.py. Groups by first digit: 0 build, 1 SPURS, 2 GCM/D3D12, 3 audio, 6 runtime/HLE/pad. Line by the rest: x001-x499 fix, x500-x899 feature, x900-x999 experiment. Upstream status comes from upstream.tsv. "Functions" are the hunk contexts, a hint for clashes, not a complete list. "Switches" are the environment variables the patch reads.
